verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly describe a unified API that gives access to hundreds of models from multiple providers with a single key. They also document an OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible endpoint and drop-in use of the OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs via a base URL swap, so developers can switch providers without rewriting code. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that cross-provider calls behave consistently (e.g. parameter/feature parity across providers is not evidenced).

support.subject: As a developer, I can call many model providers through one consistent API

citations.quote: Access models from multiple providers with a single API key
The AI Gateway's unified API provides flexibility, allowing you to switch between different AI models and providers without rewriting parts of your application.
AI Gateway provides OpenAI Chat Completions API endpoints, letting you use multiple AI providers through a familiar interface.
Point your existing OpenAI or Anthropic SDK at AI Gateway. Same calls, no rewrites.
Access hundreds of models for text, image, and video generation, realtime voice, speech to text, text to speech, embeddings, and reranking through one API.
